approval_source: Parent coordination message in this run on 2026-10-27
selection_order: Start from DEMO_J and one-to-one left join BMX_J, INS_J, DIQ_J by SEQN privately
WTSAF2YR finite and greater than zero
BMXBMI finite and greater than zero
For RIAGENDR=2 and age 20-44 require RIDEXPRG=2; for other women exclude RIDEXPRG=1
DIQ010 is 2 or 3 (no diagnosed diabetes; borderline retained)
Exclude DIQ050=1; retain other codes or missing, without interpreting missing as a confirmed no
LBXIN finite and greater than zero; LBDINLC must be 0 or 1 for any retained observation
insulin_units: uU/mL, equivalent numeric convention to microIU/mL
insulin_processing: Preserve LBXIN exactly as publicly released, including CDC fill values for below-LOD results. No deletion based on magnitude, trimming, winsorization, fitting, or scientific relationship analysis. LLOD=1.0 uU/mL; CDC uses LLOD/sqrt(2) for results below detection. Preserve LBDINLC privately.
age_definition: Age in completed years at screening; 80-plus topcoding excluded
diabetic_pills: Not an exclusion or generator input; DIQ070 is not inspected
fasting_definition: Positive WTSAF2YR as documented for the fasting subsample; no additional outcome-dependent fasting rule
pregnancy_limitation: Released pregnancy status is limited to women 20-44. This is an exclusion based on available pregnancy ascertainment, not proof of nonpregnancy at all ages.
complete_case_limitation: This is a paired complete-case evaluation cohort. NHANES weights may not adjust for remaining item nonresponse; no claim of unconditional national representativeness is automatic.
generator_blinding: Entire insulin column, original identifiers, survey design variables, assay comment flags, target summaries and reserved evaluation analyses are withheld
design_spine: All INS_J rows with positive finite WTSAF2YR, with SDMVSTRA, SDMVPSU and target domain indicator; target restriction must preserve this design frame
